title: RL's Razor: Why Online Reinforcement Learning Forgets Less
primary_track: RL, IL, offline learning, and robot data
aliases: RL's Razor: Why On-Policy Reinforcement Learning Forgets Less
problem: 새 과제를 학습할 때 기존 정책의 능력이 보존되는 조건을 묻는다.
